title: 'Silver Surfer' video, Bill Nye's brine-shrimp claim, and the Red Bull skydiver debunk
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of 'Silver Surfer' video, Bill Nye's brine-shrimp claim, and the Red Bull skydiver debunk, about c. 2008 at Santa Monica, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I posted cuz I saw this thing in the sky and I didn't know what it was. I filmed it. It's called the I called it the Silver Surfer.
